title: Topological Matter
description: Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

puzzle.goal: In a two-dimensional insulator each filled electron band carries a Berry-type curvature Ω(k) over crystal momentum space. Write the transverse conductance as the conductance quantum times the integer obtained by integrating that curvature over the whole periodic momentum cell and dividing by 2π.
puzzle.name: TKNN formula (quantised Hall conductance from the Chern number)
puzzle.form: e ^ 2 / ( 2 * π * h ) * iint ( Ω , BZ )
puzzle.ask: The integral is 2π times an integer ν. Find the Hall conductance in siemens for ν = @{ν}.

vars.\u03a9: curvature of the filled bands in momentum space
vars.BZ: the periodic momentum cell of the crystal

puzzle.method: The curvature integrated over a closed surface (the momentum torus) is quantised in units of 2π; multiply by e²/h.
